known_facts_book1: Arrives by train at Hugson's Siding in California to be met by Zeb, carrying a wicker suit-case and her kitten Eureka in a covered bird-cage.
Is greeted by Zeb with the question 'are you Dorothy Gale?'
Had travelled to Australia with Uncle Henry and is on her way home to Kansas.
Falls into a crack in the earth during an earthquake, together with Zeb, Jim the cab-horse and the buggy.
Recognizes the Wizard when his balloon descends into the Land of the Mangaboos, crying 'it's Oz!'
Helps the Wizard pick the Royal Princess from the Royal Bush, making her the new Ruler of the Mangaboos.
Journeys up through the Black Pit, the Valley of Voe and the Land of the Gargoyles toward the earth's surface.
Carries the Nome King's Magic Belt, which she left with Ozma; signals Ozma at four o'clock through the enchanted picture and is wished into the Emerald City.
Once in Oz she uses the Magic Belt to wish her stranded companions safe into the royal palace.
Reunites with her old Oz friends the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Billina, the Cowardly Lion and the Hungry Tiger.
Defends her kitten Eureka at the trial for eating Ozma's piglet, and is proved right when Eureka is found innocent.
Is sent home to Kansas by Ozma's Magic Belt at the end, holding Eureka.

known_relations_book1.Zeb: Her second cousin and travelling companion; the boy sent to fetch her from Hugson's Siding.
known_relations_book1.Eureka: Her white kitten, carried down into the earth and defended by her at the trial.
known_relations_book1.Jim: The old cab-horse that falls with her and draws the buggy through the underground lands.
known_relations_book1.the Wizard: An old friend from her first visit to Oz; they fall into the earth separately and travel back to Oz together.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The girl Ruler of Oz and her dear friend, who watches her in the enchanted picture and rescues her with the Magic Belt.
known_relations_book1.Uncle Henry: Her uncle, with whom she travelled and who waits offstage in Kansas.
known_relations_book1.Billina: Her old friend the yellow hen, whom she reunites with in Oz.

known_facts_book1: Descends into the Land of the Mangaboos in a balloon after falling into an earthquake crack during a circus ascension.
Is recognized by Dorothy as the Wizard of Oz she knew on her first visit.
Performs the trick of the nine tiny piglets, pulling one apart into many, to outdo the Mangaboo Sorcerer.
Kills the thorn-covered Sorcerer Gwig by cutting him in two with a sword made of jointed knives.
Admits to his companions that he is only a humbug, not a real wizard.
Routs the Mangaboo advisors with two lantern 'suns' and a pool of burning kerosene.
Fights the invisible bears of Voe with his sword and the wooden Gargoyles with his revolvers.
Reveals his real name is Oscar Zoroaster Phadrig Isaac Norman Henkle Emmannuel Ambroise Diggs, and that he was born in Omaha and took the initials O.Z.
Recounts building the Emerald City and uniting the four countries of Oz before leaving in a balloon.
Is welcomed back and made Ozma's Official Wizard, given his old room behind the Throne Room.
Gives the Tin Woodman a spare piglet to produce at the trial to save Eureka's life.
Keeps nine tiny piglets from the Island of Teenty-Weent in his inside pocket.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His old friend from her first Oz visit; they journey back to Oz together.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz who welcomes him back and makes him her Official Wizard.
known_relations_book1.Gwig: The Mangaboo Sorcerer he mocks and then cuts in two.
known_relations_book1.the Tin Woodman: His co-conspirator in the trick that saves Eureka at the trial.
known_relations_book1.the Scarecrow: The straw man to whom he once gave brains, welcomed warmly on his return.

known_facts_book1: A boy who works for Uncle Bill Hugson on his California ranch and meets Dorothy at Hugson's Siding with the horse and buggy.
Is Dorothy's second cousin, Uncle Hugson having married Uncle Henry's wife's sister.
His full name is Zebediah, shortened to Zeb.
Falls into the earthquake crack with Dorothy, Jim and the buggy.
Captures a crowned Gargoyle, binds its wings, and later swings it as a club he calls 'the king'.
Climbs down the tower on a strap of harness to steal the Gargoyles' unhooked wings for the escape.
Wrestles a little Munchkin champion at the Oz games and is thrown three times.
Serves on the jury at Eureka's trial.
Returns to Hugson's Ranch with Jim at the end, sent by Ozma's Magic Belt.

known_relations_book1.Uncle Hugson: His uncle and employer on the California ranch.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who sends him safely home.

known_facts_book1: An old, bony horse that once drew a public cab in Chicago, now driven by Zeb in California.
Falls into the earthquake crack drawing the buggy with Dorothy and Zeb.
Begins to talk for the first time during the fall, saying 'Well, that's better!'
Kicks and fights the Mangaboos and the wooden Gargoyles.
Is fitted with wooden Gargoyle wings and flies clumsily to escape the wooden city.
Is wished into Oz with the others and given a palace room and oatmeal to eat.
Meets the Sawhorse, boasts of being a Real Horse, and races it, losing badly.
Kicks the Sawhorse in anger after the race and is knocked flat by the Hungry Tiger.
Serves on the jury at Eureka's trial.
Claims to have been born in Kentucky and once a race horse.
Returns to Hugson's Ranch with Zeb at the end.

known_relations_book1.Zeb: The boy who drives him and takes him home.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The girl who falls with him and coaxes him onward.
known_relations_book1.the Sawhorse: The wooden horse of Oz, his rival, who beats him in the race.
known_relations_book1.the Hungry Tiger: The beast that disciplines him for kicking the Sawhorse.

known_facts_book1: Dorothy's white kitten, carried down into the earth in a covered bird-cage; she looks pink under the six colored suns of the Mangaboo country.
Named 'Eureka' because Dorothy found her ('Eureka' means 'I have found it').
Is constantly hungry and repeatedly begs to eat the Wizard's nine tiny piglets.
Can walk on the air in the Mangaboo country.
Escapes the Black Pit to fetch Dorothy and the Wizard to rescue Jim and the piglets.
Fights the Mangaboos and the Gargoyles with claws and teeth.
Scouts the Gargoyle city and reports that they unhook their wings to sleep, which enables the escape.
Is wished into Oz with Dorothy by the Magic Belt.
Snaps jealously at Billina the yellow hen.
Is arrested and put on trial for murder for allegedly eating Ozma's piglet.
Is proven innocent when the piglet is found alive in a vase, though she confesses she had intended to eat it.
Falls into disgrace afterward and returns to Kansas with Dorothy.

known_relations_book1.Billina: The yellow hen she quarrels with jealously.
